en: The mailman just dropped some mail in our box, Grandpa.
cn: 邮递员刚往我们信箱里投了些邮件，爷爷。

en: Oh, probably a lot of advertising and bills.
Why don't you write to me, Robbie, so I can get some interesting mail?
cn: 这样我也能收到些有趣的邮件？

en: Right, Grandpa.
Advertising, bills, bills, advertising.
It's just like I said, Robbie.
Nothing interesting.
You won't believe it, Grandpa.
But there's a letter here addressed to you.
cn: 但这里有一封写给你的信，

en: Mr. Malcolm Stewart, and it looks like a personal letter.
cn: 马尔科姆·斯图尔特先生，看起来像私人信件。

en: That must be a bill.
I don't think so.
The return name and address is Pete Waters, RFD number one, Chesterton.
You're joking.
cn: 你开玩笑吧。皮特·沃特斯？

en: Pete Waters?
Pete Waters, RFD number one, Chesterton.
cn: 皮特·沃特斯，切斯特顿，RFD 1 号。

en: You know him?
Do I know Pete Waters?
You bet I do.
He was my roommate in college.
He visited with Grandma and me in Florida about five years ago.
cn: 大约五年前他在佛罗里达看望过我和奶奶。

en: What does he say? Is he okay?
He's fine. Just fine.
He's writing to invite me to spend a weekend with him at his farm.
He's planning a get-together with two or three other college friends.
A kind of 50-year anniversary reunion.
Sounds like fun.
50 years? Wow.
cn: 对我来说也挺有意思，罗比。

en: Yeah, sounds like fun to me too, Robbie.
What kind of farm does he have?
I've never been there, Robbie.
But he has chickens and cows and all.
cn: 那意味着新鲜的鸡蛋和牛奶。

en: That means fresh eggs and fresh milk.
Does he have a family?
No, he doesn't, Robbie.
He never married.
He's not as lucky as I am.
I have a family and grandchildren.
I'm a lucky man.
How come he never got married?
That's a good question, Robbie.
A very good question.
He never married because the girl he was in love with in college married someone else.
As simple as that.
He never got over it.
He must have loved her very much.
Yes, very much.
Lillian Winters, she was in our class.
And what happened?
cn: 她爱上了唐纳德·麦格拉斯，

en: She was in love with Donald McGrath, the quarterback in our football team.
cn: 我们橄榄球队的四分卫。

en: Football players are always popular with the ladies.
cn: 她喜欢皮特，他们一起参加舞会。

en: She liked Pete, and they went to dances together.
But her heart was with Donald.
Did he ever get over it?
No, he never did.
Where is she today?
I don't know.
Maybe Lillian will be at the reunion.
cn: 也许莉莲会来参加重聚。

en: You think so?
Pete's full of surprises.
I wish I could go there with you, Grandpa.
cn: 真希望我能和你一起去，爷爷。

en: What do you think the surprise will be?
With Pete, you never know, Robbie.
Won't it be exciting to see all your college friends there again?
cn: 和皮特打交道，你永远不知道，罗比。

en: It is already.
cn: 又能见到所有大学朋友，不是很令人兴奋吗？

en: I'm kind of excited about going now.
Next weekend.
Sleep over Friday and Saturday night and come back Sunday.
I can't wait.
Don't you think you ought to call Pete and tell him you're coming?
You're reading my mind, Robbie.
What do I do for you?
I need a full tank.
Where abouts you headed?
The Pete Waters farm near Chesterton.
cn: 切斯特顿附近，皮特·沃特斯的农场。

en: I know it well.
Pete Waters lives around here almost as long as I have.
How long is it going to take the farmer to get there?
cn: 皮特·沃特斯住在这儿的时间和我也差不多了。

en: About 15 minutes.
There's a shortcut if you know it.
I don't.
cn: 有条近道——如果你知道的话。

en: Could you tell me how to use the shortcut?
Sure.
You take the next left turn.
cn: 你能告诉我怎么走近道吗？

en: You'll see a stop sign.
cn: 当然。你在下一个路口左转。

en: Make a right at the stop sign.
cn: 你会看到一个停车标志。

en: Stay on that road and you'll cross a blue bridge.
Then you'll see a big old red barn.
cn: 沿着那条路走，你会经过一座蓝色的桥。

en: That's the back of Pete Waters' place.
cn: 然后你会看到一个红色的大旧谷仓。

en: That's quite a difference from the directions that Pete sent me.
cn: 那就是皮特·沃特斯地方的后门。

en: Now, if you take that route, it's probably a lot simpler,
cn: 这和皮特给我的方向完全不一样。

en: but it'll take you 10 minutes longer.
cn: 如果你走那条路，可能简单得多，

en: Okay.
Let me repeat it.
Take the next left turn to the stop sign.
Then a right across a blue bridge.
cn: 我在下一个路口左转到停车标志。

en: Then a big red barn.
I can't believe it.
cn: 然后是一个红色大谷仓。

en: How much do I owe you?
Well, that'll be $18.70.
No charge for the cleanup. It's on the house.
Here's the 20.
Ah, okay. That's $1.30 change.
There we go. We'll make 20. Thanks.
cn: 啊。好的。找你一美元三十美分。

en: Thank you. Thanks for the directions.
Must be Pete's barn.
Turn right to the house.
Hi.
Hi. What can I do for you?
Is this the Pete Waters' barn?
cn: 这是皮特·沃特斯农场吗？

en: It is.
I'm a friend of Pete's. I'm looking for the house.
It's just over yonder.
Keep along this road until you get to the end of the fence.
We'll see the chicken house. His house is on the left.
Oh, thanks. Back soon with a surprise.
Think yourself at home. Have a look around.
Pete. Same old Pete Waters.
Always full of surprises.
Recognize you.
Oh, don't be silly, Arnie.
Of course you recognize him,
except for the beard he hasn't changed in 50 years.
He's Malcolm Stewart.
cn: 除了胡子，他五十年没怎么变。

en: I know it's Malcolm Stewart.
You haven't changed much in 50 years.
Peggy.
Peggy Pendleton. You're Peggy Pendleton.
Who am I, you old rascal? You don't recognize me, do you?
I know who you are.
You're Arnold Pendleton.
You look wonderful.
Sit down. Sit down.
cn: 你看起来好极了，马尔科姆！

en: Pete isn't home.
Really?
Oh, he left a note on the door
saying he was going to the railroad station
cn: 不在。他在门上留了张便条，

en: to pick up a surprise.
He's so funny. Always full of surprises.
Even 50 years later.
The two of you look unbelievable.
How's your family?
cn: 你们俩看起来太不可思议了！

en: Oh, I was sorry to hear about your wife
having passed away.
Yes, about four years ago.
And you're living with your children now in New York?
Pete wrote us and told us.
cn: 你现在和孩子们住在一起？在纽约？

en: Yep. Retired and moved to New York
to live with my son and his family.
By the way, what do you think this big surprise is?
It could be most anything knowing Pete.
cn: 你觉得这个大惊喜会是什么？

en: Hey, that must be Pete.
cn: 了解皮特的话，什么都可能。

en: Oh, we'll find out about the surprise.
So good to see you.
cn: 现在我们要知道惊喜是什么了。

en: Hi, Pete.
Hey, oh, it's so good to see you.
Remember Lillian?
I remember all of you. You haven't changed the bed.
Really?
Oh, my gosh.
We were together the thirty-night drama society.
cn: 莉莲·温特斯。莉莲·温特斯。

en: You never made that happen.
Oh, beautiful as ever, Lillian.
How's Donald?
cn: 哦，还是和以前一样漂亮，莉莲。

en: That's okay, Malcolm.
Donald passed away a couple of years ago.
Oh, I'm so sorry.
cn: 听到这个我很难过，莉莲。

en: I will not have missed this get-together for the world.
And your little surprise, Pete.
cn: 我说什么也不会错过这次聚会！

en: You really surprised me by having us all come together.
You don't know what the surprise is yet.
Come on.
cn: 你还不知道惊喜是什么吧？

en: We'll tell you the big surprise.
I've invited you here for the weekend to help celebrate.
cn: 我们告诉你这个大惊喜。

en: Celebrate?
cn: 我邀请你们来这里度周末是为了庆祝。

en: Our 50th reunion.
No.
No, Pete wants to tell you.
Now, let me have the honor, Lillian.
For goodness sake, Pete, fellas, I can't wait much longer.
Well, I am pouring this iced tea
so that we can toast Lillian and me.
You don't mean to tell me that you...
Yes, I do.
I have loved Lillian all these years,
cn: 这些年来我一直爱着莉莲，

en: so I asked her to be Mrs. Pete Waters.
cn: 所以我请她做皮特·沃特斯夫人。

en: And I said yes.
Oh, I knew it.
I knew it.
Congratulations.
Oh, Lillian, I am so happy for you both.
cn: 我为你们俩感到太高兴了。

en: It's wonderful.
It's wonderful for me.
Lillian will make me a happy man, finally.
cn: 莉莲会让我终于成为幸福的人。

en: You are full of surprises, Pete.
We are going to spend the entire weekend
cn: 我们要庆祝一整个周末。

en: having a good time together here on the farm.
We are going to celebrate all weekend.
When is the wedding?
That's another surprise.
Lillian and I were married two weeks ago in Detroit.
cn: 莉莲和我两周前在底特律结婚了。

en: What?
She's come here to stay.
Wait till I tell my family about this.
cn: 等我把这件事告诉家人！
